text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
Thank you so much for giving me time off!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I was able to binge-watch
all the pro wrestling matches I'd recorded!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally pumped up now,
so I can handle any kind of training!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Please look forward to it, deees!!
